dct_description_sm:
The Brampton Economic Development Map is unique in that it is a ‘print only’ marketing piece. It is a two sided fold out that is visually appealing with detailed information on the city. The content is updated every two years as the city is growing at such a rate that there is a large change in street network and information over 2 years.
The purpose of the map is to view the City of Brampton through a holistic, comprehensive, graphic piece that shows the geography of the city highlighting employment lands, infrastructure and amenities which are relevant to investors. The back of the map provides a detailed overview of Brampton’s value proposition that can be easily referred to.
